oddsSets.title: Player Groups
oddsSets.subtitle: Player groups are customer groups. Each one plays one odds set — set 2 falls back to set 1 and set 3 to set 2, per card — and can be a partner group: its members earn the group's referral rate instead of the tier table, and the group decides whether they can withdraw and whether phone verification applies. New sign-ups land in DEFAULT, which is locked so its members behave exactly like a player with no group. Change a player's group on their own profile page.
oddsSets.seesDraftsHint: Sees Draft on: members see Draft packs on the storefront and can spin Draft ticket packs, paying from their real balance. Draft card packs stay view-only. Staff only: this gives no access to anything else, and turning it on is recorded in the audit trail.
oddsSets.policyHint: Partner switch on: members earn the partner rate on their downline turnover, and a per-customer rate cannot be set while they are in the group. Withdrawals "Blocked" refuses bank withdrawals for every member. Phone verification "Off" lets members top up, withdraw and request delivery without a verified phone. Policy changes are recorded in the audit trail.

profit.title: Profit report
profit.subtitle: Real money in and out, Malaysia time · {{window}}
profit.subtitleAll: Real money in and out, Malaysia time · all time
profit.scopeAllHint: Count every account. Real customers leaves out money moved by other groups' accounts and generated accounts, including referral commission they earned from real customers and later withdrew.
profit.cashKeptHint: Top-ups received, minus the gateway's fees both ways, minus withdrawals paid, plus what the regional rails' exchange spread earned. Real customers only, unless All groups is on.
profit.feeFloor_one: {{count}} payment has no fee on file yet, so fees shown are a minimum.
profit.feeFloor_other: {{count}} payments have no fee on file yet, so fees shown are a minimum.
profit.owedSubtitle: Everything players hold that could still become a withdrawal, as of now.
profit.walletNote: Not counted: {{bonus}} bonus (spend-only, can't be withdrawn) and {{noTopup}} in accounts that never topped up (can't be withdrawn until they do).
profit.cardsHint: Vaulted and shipping cards of players who have topped up, at the 90% sell-back price. Includes free and promo cards.
profit.ifAllHint: All-time cash kept, minus what is still owed, minus cards already delivered (they left as goods, valued at the same sell-back price). Ignores the period picked above.
profit.movedSubtitle: Inside the site, this period. Paid credit only; promo has its own line.
profit.rtpSubtitle: Expected value back per open with today's odds and card values. Over 100% means the pack loses money.
profit.grossFloor_one: {{count}} top-up was settled by hand with no amount on file, so top-ups shown are a minimum.
profit.grossFloor_other: {{count}} top-ups were settled by hand with no amount on file, so top-ups shown are a minimum.
profit.walletHint: Cash credit (not bonus) in the wallets of players who have topped up, including money still to use on packs, plus payouts requested but not paid yet and closed weeks' referral commission not paid yet.
profit.fxHint: What the SGD and USDT rails' exchange spread earned against the market rate, as Settlement's Conversion earned.
profit.commissionNote: incl. {{amount}} referral commission not paid yet
profit.cardsNoTopupNote_one: Not counted: {{count, number}} card ({{value}}) of players who never topped up
profit.cardsNoTopupNote_other: Not counted: {{count, number}} cards ({{value}}) of players who never topped up

movedHint.sellbacks: Includes free welcome pulls and prize cards sold back: those have no matching sale or promo line.
movedHint.promo_given: Credit promos only: bonus grants, rewards, vouchers and daily rewards. Free pulls and prize cards are not here.

playerMoney.resultHint: Cash kept from this player, minus what they could still take out (wallet, payouts not paid yet, vault cards at the 90% sell-back price) and the cards already shipped to them. Bonus credit isn't counted: it can't be withdrawn.
playerMoney.contributionHint: Top-ups minus withdrawals, all time: the same number as the Players list.
playerMoney.withdrawalsHint: Payouts asked for, refunded ones taken off. A payout counts from the moment it is requested.
playerMoney.last: Last top-up {{topup}} · last withdrawal {{withdrawal}} · last pack {{open}}
playerMoney.cardsWonHint: Value of the cards they pulled from paid packs, at the price when pulled. Parts paid with bonus credit are left out.
playerMoney.returnHint: Cards won ÷ pack spend. Under 100% means their packs cost more than the cards were worth.
playerMoney.balanceNote: everything in the wallet, bonus included
playerMoney.withdrawableHint: What the withdraw button allows right now: nothing while any money is still to use on packs, then the whole balance less bonus credit. Frozen accounts and players who never topped up can't withdraw.
playerMoney.noTopupNote: Never topped up: nothing can be withdrawn
playerMoney.stillToPlayHint: Top-ups, and the free part of a sell-back (from bonus credit or the welcome pack), must be spent on packs. While any of it is left, nothing can be withdrawn; once it is all used, the whole balance except bonus credit can. Packs spend bonus credit first, so the player's app asks for bonus credit plus this amount. After a delivery fee this can exceed the balance; a top-up doesn't close that gap, only more pack spend does.
playerMoney.sellbackHint: What we would pay if they sold every card they hold back now, at the 90% vault price. Cards in delivery are included.
playerMoney.sellbackNote: if they sold everything back now
playerMoney.giftPacksNote: Packs sent from Gifts and bonus that the player has not opened yet. They open them as Vault x1 on the pack page. Revoke one from Gifts and bonus.
playerMoney.sellLocked: Can't be sold yet: a free welcome card unlocks after the first paid pack.
playerMoney.sellsPaused: Selling is paused: the exchange-rate feed is down, so the player can't sell any card right now. The prices below are indicative.
playerMoney.heldBoth: {{held}} held back: bonus credit, plus the rest until money for packs is used
playerMoney.heldPlay: {{held}} held back until the money still to use on packs is used

settings.testClockNote: Advance simulated session waits; test cycles remain one at a time with at least two seconds between them.

targets.title: Leaderboard targets
targets.description: Choose an account, a leaderboard and a rank to aim for. Preview the decision first, or test the full cycle with sandbox credits.

modeNotes.shadow: Preview reads the current board once and shows whether another draw would be needed. No credits are granted and no cards are pulled.
modeNotes.monitor: Monitor reads rank and distance to the target once. It records the result without pulling cards or sending messages.
modeNotes.test: Sandbox test uses the account’s existing isolated bonus wallet. It pulls, sells and checks total and bonus balances only while the rank decision allows it, within the limits below.

targets.buffersNote: Secure lead is the margin above the competitor at the target cutoff. A lead at or below the warning amount can trigger a defense decision. Warning must not exceed secure lead.
targets.limitNote: Current run limit: {{cycles}} cycles per account. The smaller run or target limit applies. Preview and Monitor never draw.
targets.limitsSummary: Up to {{cycles}} cycles · {{spend}} test spend · {{minutes}} min
targets.invalid: Check the account and target limits.
targets.scopeNote: With targets configured, Start runs target profiles only. All ranks and competitors belong to the synthetic test leaderboard.
targets.excluded: Not included when running the currently selected account.
targets.runSummary: Target accounts: {{targets}} · Sandbox tests: {{tests}} · Preview / Monitor: {{previews}}
targets.progressScope: Decisions and warnings from this run. Sandbox leaderboard only.
targets.previewWouldDraw: Preview decision: another draw would be needed. No draw was made.
targets.previewWouldWait: Preview decision: wait. No draw was made.
targets.standardSummary: {{count}} accounts with standard pull, sell and balance-check cycles.
targets.noSelectedTarget: The selected account has no target. Choose an account with a target or select all test profiles.
targets.stoppedNote: Run stopped. No more draws or rank checks are scheduled.
